projects.title: Secure Save – Personal Vault
projects.subtitle: Zero-Knowledge Personal Vault & Mobile Ecosystem
projects.architecturalTagline: Architected a production-grade, zero-knowledge security platform featuring client-side AES-256-GCM encryption, a stateless Node.js serverless API on Vercel, MongoDB Atlas encrypted document storage, a React 18 3D interactive WebApp, and automated Capacitor Android CI/CD.
engineeringHighlights: Zero-Knowledge Cryptography: Implemented client-side AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with 96-bit initialization vectors (IVs) and PBKDF2 (SHA-256) local key derivation; ciphertext-only transport guarantees the backend and database persist zero plaintext secrets.

Backend Engineering & Edge Security: Designed a high-throughput serverless REST API on Vercel Edge with reverse proxy trust, strict CORS firewall whitelisting, express-rate-limit brute-force mitigation, and Nodemailer SMTP delivery with 5-minute MongoDB TTL auto-purging OTP challenges.

DevOps & Multi-Platform CI/CD: Built an automated GitHub Actions CI/CD matrix compiling native Android debug APKs with Gradle 8, auto-publishing rolling release assets via softprops/action-gh-release, and syncing static builds across Capacitor and Vercel edge networks.

projects.title: SkillSync – Peer-to-Peer – Learning Platform
projects.description: Architected a production-grade platform with 9 Spring Boot microservices on AWS EC2 and a React 18 + TypeScript frontend on Vercel. Enabled role-based dashboards for Learner, Mentor, and Admin supporting mentor discovery and session workflows. Designed RESTful APIs across User, Auth, Payment, Session, and Notification services. Implemented CQRS with Redis caching and event-driven architecture using RabbitMQ for asynchronous workflows. Secured platform using JWT, OAuth, and OTP authentication.

projects.title: Godamm – Inventory Command Center
projects.description: Architected a multi-tenant inventory management platform with a Spring Boot backend and React 18 + TypeScript frontend deployed on AWS EC2 + Vercel, ensuring scalability. Designed and implemented 23+ RESTful APIs for product catalogue, supplier management, sales processing, and user authentication using Spring Boot Bean Validation at every endpoint. Delivered real-time stock tracking and atomic sales transaction processing using Spring Data JPA + MySQL. Integrated Redis caching on high-frequency read paths. Built React analytics dashboard with interactive profit charts and low-stock alert indicators. Secured with JWT stateless authentication and automated deployments using Docker Compose, Nginx, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

projects.title: Garage Management System
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end garage management platform handling customers, vehicles, services, invoices, and payments. Architected REST API layer supporting vehicle servicing and billing operations. Integrated Spring Security authentication with protected endpoints and session management. Designed an analytics dashboard showing revenue trends, customer insights, and operational metrics.
